learning_objective: 当老师对全班发出 1–2 步指令时,孩子能借视觉提示或看同伴示范跟着完成,提示≤1 次,5 次中≥4 次达成。
intro_zh: 在教室里,老师会对全班小朋友说要做什么。我可以看看墙上的步骤图,也看看旁边的小朋友,跟着大家一起做。
intro_en: In the classroom, the teacher tells the whole class what to do. I can look at the picture steps on the wall and at my friends, and do it along with everyone.

steps.text_zh: 老师说话时,我看着老师、认真听。
steps.text_en: When the teacher speaks, I look and listen.
steps.narration_zh: 老师对全班说话时,我先看着老师,认真听她说要做什么。
steps.narration_en: When the teacher talks to the class, I look at the teacher and listen carefully.

steps.text_zh: 我看看墙上的步骤图,知道要做什么。
steps.text_en: I look at the picture steps to know what to do.
steps.narration_zh: 我看看墙上的步骤图卡,就知道现在要做什么。
steps.narration_en: I look at the picture steps on the wall, and I know what to do now.

steps.text_zh: 我也看看旁边的小朋友怎么做。
steps.text_en: I also look at what my friends are doing.
steps.narration_zh: 我看看旁边的小朋友怎么做,跟着他们一起。
steps.narration_en: I look at what my friends are doing and follow along with them.

steps.text_en: I do it along with everyone.
steps.narration_zh: 我跟着全班一起,一步一步把老师说的做完。
steps.narration_en: I follow along with the whole class and finish what the teacher asked, step by step.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 老师对全班说“把书翻到第 3 页,坐好”。轮到你,试试看怎么做。
practice_trials.prompt_en: The teacher tells the class: turn to page 3 and sit up. Your turn — give it a try.
practice_trials.answer_zh: 我先看图,再照着把书翻好、坐好。
practice_trials.answer_en: I look at the picture steps, then turn to the page and sit up.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你跟着指令一步步做,做得很好。
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You followed the directions step by step. Well done.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 如果没完全听清老师说什么,你可以怎么办?
practice_trials.prompt_en: If you did not fully hear what the teacher said, what can you do?
practice_trials.answer_zh: 我看看墙上的图,或看看旁边的小朋友。
practice_trials.answer_en: I look at the picture on the wall, or at my friends.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你会用提示帮自己,真棒。
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You used the supports to help yourself. Great job.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 做完了老师说要收拾,你可以怎么做?
practice_trials.prompt_en: When the teacher says it is time to tidy up, what can you do?
practice_trials.answer_zh: 我跟着大家一起把东西收好。
practice_trials.answer_en: I tidy up together with everyone.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你和全班一起完成,做得好。
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You finished together with the whole class. Well done.

social_choice.scenario_zh: 老师对全班说要做一件事,你没完全听清……你可以怎么做?
social_choice.scenario_en: The teacher tells the class to do something and you did not fully hear... what can you do?

options.outcome_zh: 你看图就知道要做什么,顺利跟上了大家。
options.outcome_en: You look at the pictures, know what to do, and keep up with everyone.

options.outcome_zh: 你看看同伴,照着做,也跟上了全班。
options.outcome_en: You watch your friend, do the same, and keep up with the class.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 看老师听 → 看步骤图 → 跟着做
visual_cards.caption_en: Look & listen → Check the pictures → Do it along

visual_cards.caption_zh: 墙上的步骤图 · 旁边的小朋友
visual_cards.caption_en: The picture steps · My friends nearby

visual_cards.caption_zh: 听指令 → 看提示 → 一起做 → 完成
visual_cards.caption_en: Listen → Check supports → Do together → Done

visual_cards.title_en: If I miss it, that's okay
visual_cards.caption_zh: 没听清 → 看提示 → 我也能跟上
visual_cards.caption_en: Missed it → Use supports → I can still keep up

review_zh: 我学会了在教室里跟着全班一起做:看着老师认真听,看看墙上的步骤图,也看看小朋友,再跟着大家一步步做完。就算没听清,我也有办法跟上。
review_en: I learned to follow along with the class: I look at the teacher and listen, check the picture steps, watch my friends, and do it step by step with everyone. Even if I miss something, I have ways to keep up.
review_flags: 草稿:集体指令须在真实集体情境专门训练,1 对 1 会做不等于面向全班时会反应。
